fields.name: ShardDataConnection<TConfiguration> MapReaderWithCollectionsAsync family
fields.contract: For a Query contract, MapReaderWithCollectionsAsync returns a TModel instance whose scalar properties are populated from the first data-reader result set and whose CollectionMapAttributeBase-decorated collection properties are populated from the subsequent result sets, in property declaration order -- distinct from MapReaderAsync's positional TReaderResult type-argument mapping. Variants select whether the method constructs the TModel via a parameterless constructor or instead populates a TModel instance the caller supplies, and whether a named parameter is bound to the endpoint's current shard identifier before execution.
